step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor configured as a common-source amplifier, likely used as a test structure to characterize large-signal intermodulation distortion (IMD) behavior in RF CMOS power amplifiers as described in the paper.

paper_reference.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of IMD Behavior in RF CMOS Power Amplifiers

Id_bias.description: Drain current at the DC operating point (Vgs=0.9V)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law model with SKY130 parameters.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/(Vgs-Vth) = 1.29mA/V. Gain = gm * (RL || ro) = 1.29m * (2.7k || 32k) = 3.2 V/V = 10.1 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on gm and parallel combination of load resistor (2.7k) and transistor output resistance.

Vth.description: Threshold voltage measured at 10uA drain current

sky130_expected.reasoning: Extracted from DC sweep at a constant small drain current.

Vout_swing.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing for a 0.2Vpp input

sky130_expected.reasoning: Transient swing corresponds to the linear gain multiplied by input swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Complex nonlinear derivation. Typically for a short-channel NMOS at moderate inversion, IIP3 is around 10 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard performance for a single-transistor amplifier in 130nm CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC bias current, threshold voltage, AC voltage gain, and transient output swing of the single-transistor amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Single-transistor amplifier testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM1 N4 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
RL VDD N4 2.7k
VIN N2 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let id_bias = (1.8 - v(N4)) / 2700
  print id_bias

  * 2. DC Sweep for Vth
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  let id_dc = (1.8 - v(N4)) / 2700
  meas dc vth_10uA find v(N2) when id_dc=10u

  * 3. AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N4)
  meas ac low_freq_gain_db find gain_db at=10k

  * 4. Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 2u
  meas tran vout_max max v(N4)
  meas tran vout_min min v(N4)
  meas tran vout_swing param='vout_max - vout_min'

  quit
.endc
.end
